title: Gemini client -> Claude upstream golden recordings
mock_control: mock/control/claude.json (re-read per request). X-Mock-* headers do NOT traverse the gateway; use the control file.
mock_extensions_required: variant 'tool': tool_use SSE block with INVALID-args fragments (see S2d7-13; recorded)
variant 'tool-valid': tool_use SSE block with VALID fragments '{"city":"Par' + 'is"}' (see S2d7-23)
variant 'errstream': message_start + text delta + type:error event (see S2d7-14; recorded)
variant 'maxtokens': happy events with message_delta stop_reason max_tokens (see S2d7-15; recorded)
ordering_constraints: Run S2d7-10 then S2d7-19 back-to-back (<1s gap), then wait >=1s. All other cases are order-independent; reset control file to happy (or delete it) between cases.

deferred.reason: CREDENTIALED-ONLY per R-FIXTURE: Claude OAuth targets fixed api.anthropic.com; x-api-key auth, CLI fingerprint headers, anthropic-beta baselines, CCH billing, cloaking, adaptive-effort registry models and thinking signature replay are specified from source only.

cases.purpose: Gateway auth on the /v1beta generation surface: missing API key yields 401 with the string-error body and no upstream request.
cases.record: downstream status+headers+body (verbose + body); confirm mock wire log line count UNCHANGED (no upstream request)

cases.purpose: Minimal non-stream request. Pins upstream wire body (always stream:true, max_tokens 32000, metadata.user_id, cache_control on last user part, Bearer+Anthropic-Version, ?beta=true) and the aggregated Gemini response skeleton incl. promptTokenCount=0 from message_delta-only usage.
cases.record: downstream status+headers+body; full upstream wire request (method, path, headers redacted, body) from mock/logs/claude.jsonl
cases.deterministic: fixed mock SSE; user_id precomputed (sha256 of 'content:Say hello')

cases.purpose: Stream request with alt=sse. Pins the exact 3-frame SSE sequence, frame framing (data: ...\n\n), SSE headers, no event names, no [DONE].
cases.record: downstream verbose + full SSE bytes (use --raw if needed); upstream wire request

expect_downstream.body_hint: exactly three 'data: {...}\n\n' frames per spec section S2d7 §4.3 (2 text-part chunks + final STOP+usage chunk), nothing else, stream ends cleanly

cases.purpose: Stream request with NO alt parameter must produce byte-identical output to alt=sse (GetAlt maps both to SSE framing).
cases.record: downstream verbose + full SSE bytes; upstream wire request

expect_downstream.body_hint: byte-identical frames to S2d7-02 (modulo dynamic createTime)

cases.purpose: snake_case system_instruction becomes the FIRST Claude message as a user turn (own message, not merged, not top-level system).
camelCase systemInstruction is NOT read by this direction: upstream body has no system-derived message; the user turn is the only message.

functionDeclarations -> Claude tools (schema normalization: additionalProperties false + $schema draft-07), toolConfig ANY+1 name -> tool_choice tool, functionCall part -> tool_use with generated id, functionResponse -> tool_result with FIFO pairing; cache_control lands on last tool AND last message part.

requests.body: {"contents": [{"role": "user", "parts": [{"text": "What is the weather in Paris?"}]}, {"role": "model", "parts": [{"functionCall": {"name": "get_weather", "args": {"city": "Paris"}}}]}, {"role": "user", "parts": [{"functionResponse": {"name": "get_weather", "response": {"result": "sunny"}}}]}], "tools": [{"functionDeclarations": [{"name": "get_weather", "description": "Get current weather for a city", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"city": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["city"]}}]}], "toolConfig": {"functionCallingConfig": {"mode": "ANY", "allowedFunctionNames": ["get_weather"]}}}

cases.deterministic: tool id counter is request-local and starts at 1

cases.purpose: generationConfig mapping: maxOutputTokens overrides max_tokens (512), stopSequences forwarded, temperature/topP/topK stripped from the upstream body.
thinkingLevel 'low' maps to Claude thinking {type:enabled,budget_tokens:1024} for a registry-unknown (user-defined) upstream model.

requests.curl: curl -sS -v -m 60 -X POST 'http://127.0.0.1:18317/v1beta/models/cm:generateContent' -H 'x-goog-api-key: oracle-local-key-1' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"contents":[{"role":"user","parts":[{"text":"Think step by step"}]}],"generationConfig":{"thinkingConfig":{"thinkingLevel":"low"}}}'

cases.record: downstream status+headers+body; upstream wire body (thinking block is the point of this case)

cases.purpose: inlineData mapping: image/* -> {type:image, source base64}, application/* -> {type:document, source base64}; part order preserved; cache_control on last part.
Upstream 429: status+body pass downstream VERBATIM (claude wire error shape), Content-Type application/json. Run this BEFORE S2d7-19 and leave >=1s gap after it.
cases.record: downstream verbose + body; upstream wire request + the 429 the mock returned (mock-response.json)

expect_downstream.body_hint: {"type":"error","error":{"type":"rate_limit_error","message":"mock rate limit"}} — byte-identical to the mock error body

cases.deterministic: mock error mode via control file mock/control/claude.json (X-Mock-* headers do not traverse the gateway)
cases.ordering: immediately follow with S2d7-19; then wait >=1s before any further case

cases.purpose: Upstream hard-close mid-stream: client gets the 2 translated text chunks, HTTP stays 200, then one terminal 'event: error\ndata: {unexpected EOF}' frame; stream ends.
cases.record: downstream verbose + full SSE bytes including the terminal frame
cases.deterministic: after=4 events = message_start, content_block_start, 2x content_block_delta, then close

cases.purpose: countTokens on a custom-base claude upstream is computed LOCALLY (O200k over the translated Claude body): Gemini shape {totalTokens, promptTokensDetails}; NO upstream request (verify wire log line count unchanged).
cases.record: downstream status+headers+body; mock wire log line count before/after (must be unchanged)

expect_downstream.body_hint: {"totalTokens":N,"promptTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":N}]} with N = reference O200kBase count for segments [user, Say hello]; record the exact integer

cases.purpose: Claude tool_use SSE -> Gemini functionCall chunk: one frame with parts[{functionCall{name,args,id}}] AND finishReason STOP, then a second frame with empty parts + STOP + usage. REQUIRES mock variant 'tool'.

requests.curl: curl -sS -N -v -m 60 -X POST 'http://127.0.0.1:18317/v1beta/models/cm:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse' -H 'x-goog-api-key: oracle-local-key-1' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"contents":[{"role":"user","parts":[{"text":"Call the get_weather tool for Paris"}]}]}'

cases.record: downstream verbose + full SSE bytes; upstream wire request; mock variant script as mock-response.json

cases.purpose: Claude in-stream error EVENT translates to a normal data frame with Gemini error shape (fixed 400/INVALID_ARGUMENT), stream then ends cleanly. REQUIRES mock variant 'errstream'.
cases.record: downstream verbose + full SSE bytes; mock variant script

expect_downstream.body_hint: frame 1: text part chunk for 'Partial '; frame 2: data: {"error":{"code":400,"message":"mock overloaded","status":"INVALID_ARGUMENT"}}\n\n; stream ends (no terminal error frame, HTTP 200)

cases.purpose: stop_reason 'max_tokens' still yields finishReason STOP in stream chunks (the MAX_TOKENS mapping is overwritten by an unconditional STOP set). REQUIRES mock variant 'maxtokens' (happy events with stop_reason max_tokens).

requests.curl: curl -sS -N -v -m 60 -X POST 'http://127.0.0.1:18317/v1beta/models/cm:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse' -H 'x-goog-api-key: oracle-local-key-1' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"contents":[{"role":"user","parts":[{"text":"Write a long essay"}]}]}'

cases.record: downstream verbose + full SSE bytes; mock variant script

expect_downstream.body_hint: final frame has "finishReason":"STOP" (NOT MAX_TOKENS) — pins the override quirk

cases.purpose: A contents turn WITHOUT role is dropped by this direction: upstream body has messages:[] (and no cache_control injection). user_id is still derived (role-less counts as user for the seed).
Consecutive same-role turns merge into ONE Claude message (parts concatenated); assistant turn stays separate; cache_control lands on the LAST message's last part only.
alt=json (any alt value other than sse) yields RAW CONCATENATED translated chunks with no 'data: ' framing and no SSE headers from the gateway; Content-Type comes from the upstream response.

expect_downstream.body_hint: the 3 Gemini JSON objects concatenated with NO separator and no data:/event: framing; Content-Type: text/event-stream (from upstream mock)

cases.purpose: Immediately after S2d7-10's 429 (same credential, <1s): the credential is in rate-limit cooldown; request fails with HTTP 500 and the model_cooldown body carrying the VERBATIM last upstream error. Pins cooldown shape on the gemini surface.

mock.note: control file can already be reset to happy — the cooldown fires before any upstream call

expect_downstream.body_hint: {"error":{"code":"model_cooldown","message":"All credentials for model <m> are cooling down via provider claude (last error: <summary>)","model":"<m>","reset_time":"1s","reset_seconds":1,"provider":"claude","last_upstream_error":"<summary of the 429 body>"}} — exact field set/order and the model string pinned by fixture (source: sdk/cliproxy/auth/selector.go modelCooldownError)

cases.ordering: MUST run immediately (<1s) after S2d7-10; after this case wait >=1s for the cooldown to clear
cases.deterministic: cooldown window is 1s; back-to-back curls are deterministic enough — if the request lands after cooldown cleared, re-run the pair

cases.purpose: Aggregation path validation: an upstream error EVENT in the aggregated stream fails the whole request with HTTP 502 and the validator message wrap. REQUIRES mock variant 'errstream'.

expect_downstream.body_hint: {"error":{"message":"claude executor: upstream returned error event: mock overloaded","type":"server_error","code":"internal_server_error"}} — exact wrap pinned by fixture
